Metadata.title: ZARASOA
Metadata.description: University platform: courses, learning resources and homework.

Footer.about: ZARASOA brings a university's courses, learning resources and homework together, with registrations approved by the administration.

Hero.description: Your university's courses, learning resources and homework in one place. Professors publish; approved students browse and submit their work.
points: Content for your program, track and level
Submit homework online before the deadline
Available in French, English and Malagasy

panel.p1: Find your courses, learning resources and homework in a single space reserved for the members of your university.
panel.p2: Each student only sees the content of their own program, track and level.

Features.title: Everything you need to follow your studies
Features.subtitle: ZARASOA brings together what students, professors and administrators need every day.

items.title: Courses
items.desc: Professors publish their courses in the subjects assigned to them.

items.title: Learning resources
items.desc: Materials and documents attached to courses, kept in private storage.

items.title: Homework
items.desc: Professors post assignments; students submit their work before the deadline.

items.title: Targeted access
items.desc: Each student only sees content for their program, track and level.

items.title: Controlled enrollment
items.desc: Students are matched against the official register and the administration approves every registration.

How.title: From sign-up to homework in three steps
How.subtitle: A simple path designed for university students.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.desc: Create your account with the registration number from the official register, then confirm your e-mail address.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.desc: The administration checks and approves your registration before access opens.

steps.title: Study and submit
steps.desc: Browse the courses and resources for your level, then submit your homework before the deadline.

Roles.title: A space tailored to each role
Roles.subtitle: Three roles, clear permissions: everyone only accesses what concerns them.

items.title: Student
points: Browse courses and resources for their level
Access only their own program's content

Levels.title: From Licence to Master
Levels.subtitle: Content is organized by level of study.
